causal_hypothesis: A completed M15 bar that sweeps an Asian-session extreme and closes back inside the completed 00:00-07:00 UTC range creates a short-horizon liquidity-rejection edge opposite the sweep and may complement B02/F05.
candidate_catalog_rationale: Only the exact executable translation is admitted. No additional quality filter has sufficient independent causal basis before the exact mechanism is tested.

candidate_contract.entry: first raw tick timestamp >= decision_time; LONG at Ask; SHORT at Bid
candidate_contract.exit_boundary: Atlas entry boundary plus 12 completed M15 bars (3 hours)
candidate_contract.exit: first raw tick timestamp >= exit_boundary; LONG at Bid; SHORT at Ask
candidate_contract.active_position_suppression: variant-local; reject signal index i when i <= prior accepted i + 13
candidate_contract.opposite_side_same_day: permitted when not blocked by variant-local active-position suppression
candidate_contract.fold_boundary: reject when signal and frozen exit boundary are not in the same half-year fold
candidate_contract.history_policy: reject/flag when required signal, entry or exit history is unavailable
candidate_contract.missing_bar_policy: do not silently exclude; classify as unresolved and fail chronology/data-integrity gate
candidate_contract.lot_and_account_economics: normalized 0.01-lot research convention at JPY10 per pip; account margin not inferred
candidate_contract.reentry: only after frozen variant-local suppression expires
candidate_contract.error_handling: all unresolved ticks, incomplete Asian ranges and identity mismatches remain in ledgers and block portability

portable_gate.side_breadth: both sides PF>=0.75; no side is removed

external_gate_principle.access_condition: Research portable pass, candidate freeze committed, Research/Core parity pass, MT4 standalone pass and integrated pass
